notes: Complete list: 11 actions (src/actions.ts) and 6 feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts), each registered once in a single call (UpdateActions / UpdateFeedbacks). They are rebuilt on every config change.

Protocol: plain TCP socket (config field "TCP Port", default 23, "Extron devices typically use port 23"), commands are SIS-style strings terminated with CRLF (src/main.ts sendCommand): route "<in>*<out>!", all outputs "<in>*!", disconnect "0*<out>!", save preset "<n>,", recall preset "<n>.", front panel lock "1X"/"0X", reset "1Z", mute "<out>*Z" and unmute "<out>*z", volume "<v>*<out>V".

Input and output dropdowns are built at runtime from the configured device model (src/config.ts DXP_MODELS) and the per-port labels in the module config. Their ids are numbers (1 and "1" are different values); the catalog records valueType number with min 1 and max 16 (largest model) and describes the pattern in choicesNote.
set_volume and mute_output reuse getOutputChoices(): the "Audio Output" dropdown lists the video outputs of the model, not a separate audio list.
The reset_device callback sends "1Z" only when the "confirm" checkbox is true; the default is false.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.3: options do not support expressions.
